items.title: Poetic Imagery of Time and Atmosphere
items.explanation: The poem uses the transition from 'blue dark' to 'black' to indicate that evening has arrived. This change in color signifies the end of the day, which is why the children stop playing and go home.

items.title: Personification of Night
items.explanation: The poet personifies night by giving it the quality of 'winning.' The poem states that 'Night wins!' because the time for play has ended, marking the end of the day and the beginning of night.

items.title: Physical Effort and Exhaustion
items.explanation: The children run so fast that they cannot even catch their breath. This indicates extreme physical exertion caused by running in the cold grass.
